verdict.rationale: Inngest documents and runtime-verifies an official MCP server ('Connect Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or another MCP client to inspect and operate Inngest') with both a hosted Cloud endpoint (confirmed live via OAuth challenge) and a local Dev Server MCP option. This is a genuine server-side MCP offering appropriate for an infrastructure/workflow product, not a client-only integration. Missing for 10: independent/community usage reports of the MCP server in practice beyond vendor docs and probes.
